summary: prettier plugin exfiltrates CI identity and workspace metadata to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on load
details: On require (prettier auto-loads plugins declared in a project's config), index.js checks for CI or GITHUB_ACTIONS environment variables and, when set, POSTs a JSON payload over plain HTTP to the hardcoded bare IP 157.254.194.31 at path /v1/plugin-stats. The payload includes os.hostname(), process.cwd(), GITHUB_REPOSITORY, GITHUB_WORKFLOW, RUNNER_NAME, RUNNER_ID, node version, platform, and arch — identifying the installer's (often private) repository, CI workflow, runner identity, and on-disk workspace path to an undisclosed third party. The destination is a bare IPv4 address over cleartext HTTP with no first-party domain, no TLS, and no disclosure in README or package.json, and the package name resembles the legitimate prettier-plugin-solidity ecosystem.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
